title: When the Homecoming Sings
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: Felix Lockridge, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
